metadata.title: Graphic Pop Portrait with Gold Outlines

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome portrait centered on a flat, vibrant red field, featuring loose gold-colored line art that traces and exaggerates the subject's silhouette.
triggerTerms: red background with blue geometric accent
excludeWhen: soft pastel color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A central black-and-white photographic figure wearing dark clothing and voluminous hair, set against a solid, saturated red background. The figure is overlaid with a thick, hand-drawn gold line that follows the contour of the body and hair in a stylized, slightly offset manner. A blue trapezoidal shape sits in the upper right quadrant, serving as a base for minimalist typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome subject against a primary red field
Gold line art echoing the subject's silhouette
Blue geometric shape providing a cool-toned anchor
Minimalist sans-serif type framing the graphic element
coreInvariants: Black and white photography for the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Vertical figure centered horizontally, occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-contrast face of the subject and the blue trapezoid in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, follows the gold line down the body, and moves to the blue graphic and text in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive solid red field surrounding the central figure.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold (Line Art) and Cobalt Blue (Geometric Shape)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with high value contrast in the central figure.

composition.position: Top right, above and below the blue shape

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in two different sizes/positions for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the specific era's editorial look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a person with voluminous hair against a solid red background. Overlay a thick, hand-drawn gold line that loosely traces the silhouette. Include a solid blue trapezoid in the upper right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add geometric sans-serif text in white, all-caps, with wide tracking above and below the blue trapezoid.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, untextured red?
Is the gold line art loose and slightly offset from the body?
Is the blue shape a flat geometric trapezoid?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on geometric shapes

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gold line does not obscure the face.
Check that the blue shape is perfectly flat without shading.
Verify the text is legible and widely spaced.
Confirm the background is a single uniform color.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W subject + Solid primary color background + Stylized gold contour line + Geometric accent shape with minimalist sans-serif type.
